title: unrecognized-inline-option fails whenever we try to parse something other than Python files

labels.name: Good first issue
labels.description: Friendly and approachable by new contributors

body:
### Steps to reproduce
1. Have a Python project with in-place Cython modules (e.g. https://github.com/SFTtech/openage)
2. Run pylint multiprocess: `pylint --jobs=2 openage`
3. Observe glorious crash and deadlock
